boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten distinct Spelman and AUC Woodruff Library environments with documented study functions, equipment, or access rules.

cards.entity_name: Beverly Daniel Tatum Suites, First Floor Study Room
cards.title: Tatum Suites First Floor Study Room
cards.subtitle: Beverly Daniel Tatum Suites • Spelman College
cards.notes: Head to the first-floor study room when you need a campus study setting; registered students have 24-hour access except where noted.
cards.short_summary: A designated study room in Spelman’s Tatum Suites.
cards.evidence_claim: Spelman lists the Beverly Daniel Tatum Suites First Floor Study Room among campus study locations with 24-hour access for registered students except where noted.
cards.source_title: Robert W. Woodruff AUC Library | Spelman College
cards.access_notes: For registered students; Spelman says listed campus study locations have 24-hour access except where noted.

cards.title: Laura Spelman Hall Lower Level
cards.subtitle: Laura Spelman Hall • Spelman College
cards.notes: Use the lower level for a computer-lab-and-study-space option; the College identifies this ground-floor area as accessible 24 hours to Spelman students.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour lower-level study area with a computer lab.
cards.evidence_claim: Spelman lists Laura Spelman Hall’s lower level as a campus study location and states its ground floor has a computer lab and study spaces accessible 24 hours a day for all Spelman students.
cards.access_notes: Accessible 24 hours a day for all Spelman students, according to the College.

cards.title: Science Center Computer Lab 230
cards.subtitle: Albro-Falconer-Manley Science Center • Spelman College
cards.notes: Bring computer-based coursework to Lab 230 in the Science Center; it is one of Spelman’s listed campus study locations for registered students.
cards.short_summary: A named computer lab designated on Spelman’s study-location list.
cards.evidence_claim: Spelman lists Albro-Falconer-Manley Science Center, Computer Lab 230 among campus study locations with 24-hour access for registered students except where noted.
cards.source_title: Robert W. Woodruff AUC Library | Spelman College
cards.access_notes: For registered students; Spelman says listed campus study locations have 24-hour access except where noted.

cards.title: Wellness Center Throughway
cards.subtitle: Wellness Center at Read Hall • Spelman College
cards.notes: Set up in the Wellness Center Throughway for a documented on-campus study location; confirm any building-specific limits before relying on late access.
cards.short_summary: A designated study location in Spelman’s Wellness Center.
cards.evidence_claim: Spelman lists the Wellness Center Throughway among campus study locations with 24-hour access for registered students except where noted.
cards.source_title: Robert W. Woodruff AUC Library | Spelman College
cards.access_notes: For registered students; Spelman says listed campus study locations have 24-hour access except where noted.

cards.title: Graduate Study Suite
cards.subtitle: Lower Level • Robert W. Woodruff AUC Library
cards.notes: Choose the Graduate Study Suite when quiet matters: the Library designates it as a quiet zone, so conversations and cell-phone use are not permitted.
cards.short_summary: A lower-level library quiet zone for focused work.
cards.evidence_claim: The AUC Woodruff Library designates the Lower Level Graduate Study Suite as a quiet zone where noise and cell-phone conversations are not permitted.
cards.source_title: Library Noise Policy | Robert W. Woodruff Library
cards.access_notes: Follow library quiet-zone rules: no noise or cell-phone conversations. Check current library hours before visiting.

cards.title: Quiet Study Room
cards.subtitle: Lower Level • Robert W. Woodruff AUC Library
cards.notes: Use the named Quiet Study Room for silent reading or writing; keep calls and conversations outside because the Library designates it as a quiet zone.
cards.short_summary: A lower-level room explicitly designated for quiet study.
cards.evidence_claim: The AUC Woodruff Library designates the Lower Level Quiet Study Room as a quiet zone where noise and cell-phone conversations are not permitted.
cards.source_title: Library Noise Policy | Robert W. Woodruff Library
cards.access_notes: Follow library quiet-zone rules: no noise or cell-phone conversations. Check current library hours before visiting.

cards.title: Group Study Rooms 306–309
cards.subtitle: Upper Level • Robert W. Woodruff AUC Library
cards.notes: Reserve a room if your group needs an upper-level setting, then keep voices low: Rooms 306–309 sit within a Library-designated quiet-zone area.
cards.short_summary: Named upper-level group rooms within a quiet-zone area.
cards.evidence_claim: The AUC Woodruff Library identifies Group Study Rooms 306-309 on the Upper Level as designated quiet-zone areas.
cards.source_title: Library Noise Policy | Robert W. Woodruff Library
cards.access_notes: The Library has 14 collaborative study rooms reservable by AUC students and faculty with valid AUC ID, up to 3 hours per day.

cards.title: Woodruff Library Smart Rooms
cards.subtitle: Main Level • Robert W. Woodruff AUC Library
cards.notes: Book a Smart Room when your group needs to share a laptop screen; the three main-level rooms have flatscreen televisions for display.
cards.short_summary: Three main-level group-study rooms with display screens.
cards.evidence_claim: The AUC Woodruff Library offers three main-level Smart Rooms with flatscreen televisions that display a laptop screen for group study.
cards.source_title: Borrow Equipment & Technology | Robert W. Woodruff Library
cards.access_notes: Reserve through the Library’s group-study-room process; valid AUC ID is required for AUC student and faculty reservations.

cards.title: Presentation Practice Suites
cards.subtitle: Main Level • Robert W. Woodruff AUC Library
cards.notes: Reserve a presentation suite to rehearse and record; its camera and workstation let you review a run-through before class or an event.
cards.short_summary: Two main-level suites for recording and reviewing presentations.
cards.evidence_claim: The AUC Woodruff Library has two main-level presentation practice suites with cameras and workstations for recording presentations.
cards.source_title: Study Room & Event Reservations | Robert W. Woodruff Library
cards.access_notes: Reservation required; check the Library’s current reservation system and operating hours before visiting.

cards.title: Audio/Video Editing Suites
cards.subtitle: Rooms 205 and 206 • Robert W. Woodruff AUC Library
cards.notes: Reserve Room 205 or 206 for multimedia coursework; each suite includes an iMac, microphone, and audio interface for focused editing work.
cards.short_summary: Two reservable technology suites for multimedia projects.
cards.evidence_claim: The AUC Woodruff Library’s two audio/video editing rooms, 205 and 206, include an AKG microphone, Focusrite interface box, and Apple iMac desktop computer.
cards.source_title: Audio/Video Editing Suite Reservation | Robert W. Woodruff Library
cards.access_notes: Reservation required for AUC students; leave student ID with Technology Design Suite staff at check-in and do not bring food or drinks.
